_meta.description: Tenders and contract packages for Line 2B. Values in crore INR. 'tender_status' is floated, bids_opened, awarded, cancelled or unknown. Only packages whose source was read are listed; more (track CA-273, power, signalling, trains) wait for a source.

tenders.scope: Viaduct and stations of the western section, about 12.7 km from D N Nagar towards BKC
tenders.notes: Ended in January 2020 for poor progress; the balance became L2B-C101 (The Metro Rail Guy).

tenders.scope: Viaduct and 6 stations, MTNL Metro to Chembur, Kurla Terminus included
tenders.notes: Value is the lowest bid. Ended in January 2020 for poor progress; the balance became L2B-C102.

tenders.scope: Viaduct and 5 stations, Diamond Garden to Mandale depot
tenders.notes: Neeraj-Guan (JV) was the lowest bidder in February 2018 at Rs 393.01 crore and was named on 3 Mar 2018; the package went to NCC in April 2019 after re-bidding (The Metro Rail Guy). NCC's value was not found.
Ended in January 2020 for poor progress; the balance became L2B-C103.

tenders.scope: Balance works of CA-04B: 12.824 km of viaduct and 10 stations, ESIC Nagar to ILFS
tenders.notes: Without the station finishing and steel roofs. J Kumar bid Rs 1,389.48 crore, 18.99% above the estimate; the value was settled after about six months of talks.

tenders.scope: Balance works of CA-06: 5.868 km of viaduct and 5 stations, MTNL Metro to Chembur
tenders.notes: MMRDA's tender system lists the letter of award as 6 Apr 2023; The Metro Rail Guy's update says it may have been awarded in 2022. NCC bid Rs 791.15 crore in October 2021, 24.45% above the estimate; the final value is not published.

tenders.scope: Balance civil works of the Mandale depot (CA-14)
tenders.notes: Ahluwalia bid Rs 543.28 crore; Rs 530.32 crore after negotiation. The depot takes up to 72 trains of eight cars.

tenders.scope: Electrical and mechanical works, five stations from Diamond Garden to Mandale
tenders.notes: Completion period 1,008 days. Escalators (CA-250, Rs 25.85 crore) and lifts (CA-251, Rs 9.45 crore) went to Johnson Lifts, the same source reports.
